# Vendored from pbakaus/impeccable (two reference documents only)

Source: https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable at commit `8a0e198da34ebc5b936a9d5975fb7a3b1cf353b7` (Apache-2.0, see LICENSE).

| File | Upstream path |
|------|---------------|
| craft-floor.md | .claude/skills/impeccable/reference/craft-floor.md |
| operate.md | .claude/skills/impeccable/reference/operate.md |

Only these plain-text references are included. Impeccable's launcher, which downloads a binary on first run, and its design-detector hook are deliberately not included. Mentions of "the design hook", SKILL.md, "the committed visual world" or other Impeccable files refer to Impeccable itself; in Itqan the visual world is the UX Spec's "Visual direction" and tokens, and the checks are run by the design-critic agent and scripts/ui-scan.mjs.
